options.name: activation_keys
options.description: Activation keys for subscription-manager client, required for CentOS and Red Hat Enterprise Linux. Required only if host group has no activation keys.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_CA_PATH) will be used instead.

options.name: force
options.description: Clear any previous registration and run C(subscription-manager) with C(--force).

options.name: hostgroup
options.description: Host group to register the host in.

options.name: ignore_subman_errors
options.description: Ignore C(subscription-manager) errors for C(subscription-manager register) command.

options.name: insecure
options.description: Enable insecure argument for the initial C(curl).

options.name: jwt_expiration
options.description: Expiration of the authorization token (in hours).

options.name: lifecycle_environment
options.description: Lifecycle environment for the host. Deprecated: The Lifecycle Environment of a Host should be set by the Activation Key. Removed from the API since Katello 4.12.

options.name: location
options.description: Location to register the host in.

options.name: oauth1_consumer_key
options.description: OAuth1 consumer key for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_KEY) will be used instead.

options.name: oauth1_consumer_secret
options.description: OAuth1 consumer secret for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_SECRET) will be used instead.

options.name: operatingsystem
options.description: Operating System to register the host in. Operating system must have a C(host_init_config) template assigned.

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization to register the host in.

options.name: packages
options.description: Packages to install on the host when registered. Multiple packages are to be given as a space delimited string.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: remote_execution_interface
options.description: Identifier of the Host interface for Remote execution.

options.name: repo
options.description: Repository URL (yum/dnf) or full sources.list entry (apt). Deprecated: Use the I(repo_data) option instead. This option was deprecated in version Foreman 3.11.

options.name: repo_data
options.description: Array with repository URL and corresponding GPG key URL. Each element is a dictionary with keys C(repo) and C(repo_gpg_key_url).

options.name: repo_gpg_key_url
options.description: URL of the GPG key for the repository. Deprecated: Use the I(repo_data) option instead. This option was deprecated in version Foreman 3.11.

options.name: server_url
options.description: URL of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_SERVER_URL) will be used instead.

options.name: setup_container_registry_certs
options.description: If this is set to C(true), container registry certificates will be installed on the host.

options.name: setup_insights
options.description: If this is set to C(true), C(insights-client) will be installed and registered on Red Hat family operating systems.

options.name: setup_remote_execution
options.description: If this is set to true, SSH keys will be installed on the host.

options.name: setup_remote_execution_pull
options.description: If this is set to true, pull provider client will be deployed on the host.

options.name: smart_proxy
options.description: Name of Smart Proxy. This Proxy must have both the C(Templates) and C(Registration) features enabled.

options.name: update_packages
options.description: Update all packages on the host.

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(requests-gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/requests-gssapi) to be installed. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USE_GSSAPI) will be used instead.

options.name: username
options.description: Username accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to verify the TLS certificates of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
